channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from morningNewsSection1, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Canada to Retaliate with Tariffs Starting Sept. 8 After U.S. Imposes Duties
item.description: The U.S. has placed 50% tariffs on $20 billion of Canadian goods. PM Carney says Canada will match these tariffs 'dollar for dollar.'

item.title: As Flock Faces Scrutiny, Other Police Surveillance Firms See Opportunity
item.description: Many cities have canceled Flock contracts, some switching to rivals, but privacy advocates say these alternatives offer no improvement.

item.title: Opinion: Mr. Rogers finds a new neighborhood
item.description: MLB catcher Jake Rogers has faced uncertainty recently, moving between the Tigers, Orioles, and Red Sox.

item.title: Inherent, founded by DeepMind alumni, says its AI 'teammate' outperforms rivals at replicating research
item.description: British AI lab Inherent, created by DeepMind alumni, released Faraday, an AI agent that can replicate scientific papers, potentially advancing research.
